Anuj Agnihotri, AIR-1, UPSC CSE 2025 IAS Topper
image: anuj agnihotri, air 1, upsc 2025 topper

Anuj Agnihotri , a 26-year-old MBBS graduate, has secured All India Rank 1 in the UPSC CSE 2025 in his 3rd attempt. Hailing from Rawatbhata City in Rajasthan, he has been brilliant in academics since his childhood and scored 10 CGPA in his High School.

Before securing rank-1 this year, he was also selected last year and was serving as a DANICS probationer SDM in Delhi. His journey reflects determination, consistent study, and commitment to public service. As an IAS topper of the UPSC 2025 exam, he inspired lakhs of UPSC aspirants through his dedication and disciplined study. He switched his career from medicine to civil services because of his passion for the field of governance and policy.

About Anuj Agnihotri & His Preparation Journey

Anuj Agnihotri was born in the Rawatbhata town of Chittorgarh district in Rajasthan. He completed his initial schooling from Atomic Energy Central School in Rajasthan before pursuing graduation from AIIMS Jodhpur. His father is working at the Rajasthan Atomic Power Plant.

Anuj Agnihotri started his preparation after completing his medical studies because he wanted to work in public service . He dedicated himself to studying NCERT materials and standard textbooks while practising previous year questions, mock tests and conducting regular study sessions. His Mains results improved through answer writing practice, while he built confidence through complete DAF preparation and mock interviews, which led to his success in becoming an IAS topper of UPSC CSE 2025.

Which Courses were taken by Anuj Agnihotri at NEXT IAS?
During the journey of UPSC Preparation, Anuj Agnihotri (AIR-1 UPSC CSE 2025) took the coaching for the current affairs course (CA-VA) from NEXT IAS.

Current Affairs plays a significant role in the preparation of the UPSC Civil Services exam, be it prelims, mains or interview. In the Prelims Exam, on average, 30-35 questions are asked directly based on current affairs. The applied weightage of current affairs is significantly higher in the mains because answers are to be written analytically with static cum current approach. Similarly, knowledge of current issues is equally crucial for the final stage i.e Personality Test or Interview.
